ma.authorize(Object object)

Send an authorization request to the user in advance. After this API is invoked, a dialog box is displayed immediately, asking the user whether to authorize the Mini Program to use a function or obtain some user data. However, the corresponding API is not invoked. If the user has agreed to the authorization, no dialog box is displayed and a success message is returned. For details, see User authorization.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
scope String Yes Scope of the permission to be obtained. For details, see Scope list.
desc String No Purpose information. This parameter will be displayed in the permission popup.（Added in 26.6.0-LG0001）
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

//You can use ma.getSetting to check whether the scope.location is authorized to the user.
ma.getSetting({
  success(res) {
    if (!res.authSetting['scope.location']) {
      ma.authorize({
        scope: 'scope.location',
        desc: '',
        success () {
// The user has agreed that the Mini Program uses the location information. No dialog box will be displayed when the ma.getLocation API is invoked.
          ma.getLocation()
        }
      })
    }
  }
})
